title: Amendment of bylaws.
bodyText: The bylaws of a corporation may be amended only upon receiving the affirmative vote or written consent of at least two-thirds of the shareholders.
bodyHtml: [§421I-2]  Amendment of bylaws.  The bylaws of a corporation may be amended only upon receiving the affirmative vote or written consent of at least two-thirds of the shareholders. [L 1993, c 282, pt of §1]
